Select SystemLogCategoryID,SystemLogVal01 as ScheduleID,SystemLogVal03 as PartitionSet from EIDS_ENC.Application.SystemLog
Where SystemLogCategoryID ='1003' and SystemLogVal01=@{variables('v_ScheduleID')}

Select distinct APPL.ApplsourceCd,SCLG.ScheduleDateRangeStartDtTm,SCLG.ScheduleDateRangeEndDtTm,APPL.ApplSourceID,APPL.BenefitID,
 Case when APPL.BenefitID ='MDCR' then 'ALL' else APPL.StateID end As StateID,SysScheduleLogKey
From EIDS_ENC.Application.SystemLog SYLG
Join EIDS_ENC.Application.ScheduleLog SCLG
On SYLG.SystemLogVal01 = SCLG.ScheduleID
Join EIDS_ENC.Config.Applsources APPL
ON APPL.ApplSourceID = SCLG.ApplSourceID
Where  SYLG.SystemLogCategoryID='1001'
   And SCLG.ISActive = 1
   And SCLG.IsReserved = 1
   And SYLG.SystemLogVal01 =@{variables('v_ScheduleID')}
   AND SYLG.SystemLogKey = @{variables('v_SystemLogKey')}

If exists (select * from eids_enc.Config.ProcessControl Where ApplSourceID ='KYMCDDMS001' and IsActive =1)
				Select distinct case when ProcessControlVal01 >=1 then '1'
                else '0'
				end as IsHistoryClmList
				from eids_enc.Config.ProcessControl Where ApplSourceID = 'KYMCDDMS001' and IsActive =1
Else
BEGIN
		Select '0' as IsHistoryClmList
End

where  SLG.SystemLogCategoryID='1003'
and  SLG.SystemLogVal04=@{variables('v_Appl_Src_Id')}

v_GMLanding_Import_ServiceLineFilter_Sql.defaultValue:
Declare @SysPartitionKeyStart varchar(27) = (Select distinct SysPartitionKeyStart from ##GM_Landing_ScheduleApplSources_10000416 (nolock))
Declare @SysPartitionKeyEnd varchar(27) = (Select distinct SysPartitionKeyEnd from ##GM_Landing_ScheduleApplSources_10000416 (nolock))
;

Select CLFR.SysSrcPartitionKey									 As SysSrcPartitionKey
	  ,Substring(Convert(Varchar(10),SVLN.SysPartitionKey),1,4)  As SysPartitionKey
	  ,SVLN.SysServiceLineKey                                    As SysSrcServiceLineKey
	  ,CLFR.SysSrcClaimKey									     As SysSrcClaimKey
	  ,CLFR.SysClaimKey                                          As SysClaimKey
	  ,NewID()													 As SysServiceLineKey
	  ,'10000416'           As SysBatchLogKey
	  ,'10001363'         As SysLoadLogKey
	  ,SVLN.SystemID                                             As SystemID
	  ,SVLN.SourceID											 As SourceID
	  ,SVLN.ApplSourceID										 As ApplSourceID
	  ,SVLN.StateID												 As StateID
	  ,SVLN.ServiceID											 As ServiceID
	  ,SVLN.ServiceLineSeq                                       As ServiceLineSeq
	  ,SVLN.ServiceLineStartDt 									 As ServiceLineStartDt
	  ,SVLN.ServiceLineEndDt									 As ServiceLineEndDt
	  ,SysDateTime()											 As SysAddedDtTm
  From EIDS_ENC.vwEncounters.ServiceLines					        SVLN (nolock)
 Inner Join
       ##GM_landing_ClaimFilter_10000416							        CLFR (nolock)
	On 	CLFR.SysSrcPartitionKey                                   = SVLN.SysPartitionKey
		And CLFR.SysSrcClaimKey                                   = SVLN.SysClaimKey				  
 Where SVLN.SysPartitionKey                   Between @SysPartitionKeyStart
                                                   And @SysPartitionKeyEnd
	   And SVLN.IsActive= '1'

v_GMLanding_Import_ClaimList_ServiceLine.defaultValue:
Declare @SysPartitionKeyStart varchar(27) = (Select distinct SysPartitionKeyStart from ##GM_Landing_ScheduleApplSources_10000416 (nolock))
Declare @SysPartitionKeyEnd varchar(27) = (Select distinct SysPartitionKeyEnd from ##GM_Landing_ScheduleApplSources_10000416 (nolock))
 
;

Select CLFR.SysSrcPartitionKey									 As SysSrcPartitionKey
	  ,Substring(Convert(Varchar(10),SVLN.SysPartitionKey),1,4)  As SysPartitionKey
	  ,SVLN.SysServiceLineKey                                    As SysSrcServiceLineKey
	  ,CLFR.SysSrcClaimKey									     As SysSrcClaimKey
	  ,CLFR.SysClaimKey                                          As SysClaimKey
	  ,NewID()													 As SysServiceLineKey
	  ,SVLN.SystemID                                             As SystemID
	  ,SVLN.SourceID											 As SourceID
	  ,SVLN.ApplSourceID										 As ApplSourceID
	  ,SVLN.StateID												 As StateID
	  ,SVLN.ServiceID											 As ServiceID
	  ,SVLN.ServiceLineSeq                                       As ServiceLineSeq
	  ,SVLN.ServiceLineStartDt 									 As ServiceLineStartDt
	  ,SVLN.ServiceLineEndDt									 As ServiceLineEndDt
	  ,'10000416'           As SysBatchLogKey
	  ,'10001363'         As SysLoadLogKey
	  ,SysDateTime()											 As SysAddedDtTm
  From EIDS_ENC.vwEncounters.ServiceLines					        SVLN (nolock)
 Inner Join
       ##GM_landing_ClaimFilter_10000416							        CLFR (nolock)
	On 	CLFR.SysSrcPartitionKey                                   = SVLN.SysPartitionKey
		And CLFR.SysSrcClaimKey                                   = SVLN.SysClaimKey	
 Inner Join
       ##GM_Landing_ScheduleClaims_10000416                                  SCLM (nolock)
    On SVLN.ClaimID						                          = SCLM.ClaimID	
 Where SVLN.SysPartitionKey                   Between @SysPartitionKeyStart
                                                   And @SysPartitionKeyEnd
	   And SVLN.IsActive= '1'
       And SVLN.SystemID							IN ('CRW','ACR')
       And SCLM.ISCRW = 1


UNION ALL

Select CLFR.SysSrcPartitionKey									 As SysSrcPartitionKey
	  ,Substring(Convert(Varchar(10),SVLN.SysPartitionKey),1,4)  As SysPartitionKey
	  ,SVLN.SysServiceLineKey                                    As SysSrcServiceLineKey
	  ,CLFR.SysSrcClaimKey									     As SysSrcClaimKey
	  ,CLFR.SysClaimKey                                          As SysClaimKey
	  ,NewID()													 As SysServiceLineKey
	  ,SVLN.SystemID                                             As SystemID
	  ,SVLN.SourceID											 As SourceID
	  ,SVLN.ApplSourceID										 As ApplSourceID
	  ,SVLN.StateID												 As StateID
	  ,SVLN.ServiceID											 As ServiceID
	  ,SVLN.ServiceLineSeq                                       As ServiceLineSeq
	  ,SVLN.ServiceLineStartDt 									 As ServiceLineStartDt
	  ,SVLN.ServiceLineEndDt									 As ServiceLineEndDt
	  ,'10000416'           As SysBatchLogKey
	  ,'10001363'         As SysLoadLogKey
	  ,SysDateTime()											 As SysAddedDtTm
  From EIDS_ENC.vwEncounters.ServiceLines					        SVLN (nolock)
 Inner Join
       ##GM_landing_ClaimFilter_10000416							        CLFR (nolock)
	On 	CLFR.SysSrcPartitionKey                                   = SVLN.SysPartitionKey
		And CLFR.SysSrcClaimKey                                   = SVLN.SysClaimKey	
 Inner Join
       ##GM_Landing_ScheduleClaims_10000416                                  SCLM (nolock)
    On SVLN.ClaimID						                          = SCLM.ClaimID	
 Where SVLN.SysPartitionKey                   Between @SysPartitionKeyStart
                                                   And @SysPartitionKeyEnd
	   And SVLN.IsActive= '1'
       And SVLN.SystemID						NOT	IN ('CRW','ACR')
       And SCLM.ISCRW = 0
;

v_GMLanding_Import_ClaimFilter_Sql.defaultValue:
Declare @vISDateOFServiceEnabled bit
Select @vISDateOFServiceEnabled=ISDateOFServiceEnabled from ##GM_Landing_ScheduleApplSources_10000416

IF @vISDateOFServiceEnabled=1
BEGIN
Select 
       CLMH.SysPartitionKey										 As SysSrcPartitionKey
	  ,Substring(Convert(Varchar(10),CLMH.SysPartitionKey),1,4)  As SysPartitionKey
	  ,CLMH.SysClaimKey                                          As SysSrcClaimKey
	  ,NewID()												     As SysClaimKey
	  ,CLMH.SystemID
	  ,CLMH.SourceID
	  ,CLMH.ApplSourceID
	  ,CLMH.StateID
	  ,CLMH.ServiceID
	  ,CLMH.ClaimTyp
	  ,CLMH.ClaimSubTyp
      ,CLMH.ClaimPaidDt
	  ,'10000416'           As SysBatchLogKey
	  ,'10001363'         As SysLoadLogKey
	  ,SysDateTime()											 As SysAddedDtTm
  From EIDS_ENC.vwEncounters.Claims					  CLMH (nolock)
 Inner Join
       ##GM_Landing_ScheduleApplSources_10000416               SAPS (nolock)
    On CLMH.ApplSourceID						    = SAPS.ApplSourceID			
   And CLMH.ServiceID                               = SAPS.ServiceID 					  
   And CLMH.ClaimTyp                                = SAPS.ClaimTyp 													
   And CLMH.ClaimSubTyp                             = SAPS.ClaimSubTyp
 Where CLMH.SysPartitionKey                   Between SAPS.SysPartitionKeyStart
                                                  And SAPS.SysPartitionKeyEnd
   And CLMH.ClaimServiceStartDt                       Between SAPS.ServiceDtStart
                                                        And SAPS.ServiceDtEnd
   And CLMH.IsActive= '1'
;

END

ELSE 

BEGIN

Select 
       CLMH.SysPartitionKey										 As SysSrcPartitionKey
	  ,Substring(Convert(Varchar(10),CLMH.SysPartitionKey),1,4)  As SysPartitionKey
	  ,CLMH.SysClaimKey                                          As SysSrcClaimKey
	  ,NewID()												     As SysClaimKey
	  ,CLMH.SystemID
	  ,CLMH.SourceID
	  ,CLMH.ApplSourceID
	  ,CLMH.StateID
	  ,CLMH.ServiceID
	  ,CLMH.ClaimTyp
	  ,CLMH.ClaimSubTyp
      ,CLMH.ClaimPaidDt
	  ,'10000416'           As SysBatchLogKey
	  ,'10001363'         As SysLoadLogKey
	  ,SysDateTime()											 As SysAddedDtTm
  From EIDS_ENC.vwEncounters.Claims					  CLMH (nolock)
 Inner Join
       ##GM_Landing_ScheduleApplSources_10000416               SAPS (nolock)
    On CLMH.ApplSourceID						    = SAPS.ApplSourceID			
   And CLMH.ServiceID                               = SAPS.ServiceID 					  
   And CLMH.ClaimTyp                                = SAPS.ClaimTyp 													
   And CLMH.ClaimSubTyp                             = SAPS.ClaimSubTyp
 Where CLMH.SysPartitionKey                   Between SAPS.SysPartitionKeyStart
                                                  And SAPS.SysPartitionKeyEnd
   And CLMH.ClaimPaidDt                       Between SAPS.ClaimPaidDtStart
                                                         And SAPS.ClaimPaidDtEnd
   And CLMH.IsActive= '1'


END
